newsitem.title: CANADA: Cineplex settles strike with projectionists. [CORRECTED 23:39 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cineplex settles strike with projectionists. [CORRECTED 23:39 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects to delete paragraphs detailing new agreement. Details have yet to be released.)
Cineplex Odeon Corp said on Monday it forged a deal with striking projectionists from the International Alliance of Theatrical Stage Employees (IATSE), who have been locked out since October 28.
"We are pleased to have reached an amicable resolution with Local 173," said Cineplex President Allen Karp. "We look forward to the projectionists coming back to work."
The theater chain owner said the members of IATSE Local 173 are scheduled to return to work on Tuesday February 25, 1997, pending ratification of the new agreement.
Details of the agreement were not released.
